"Create a complete open-world GTA-style game called GRAND CITY LIFE 3D, very big, playable on Android.

MAIN CHARACTER:
- Player is a young man in Campina Grande style city, wearing hoodie, cap and sneakers.
- Can walk, run, jump, punch, shoot, enter cars, drive cars and motorcycles.
- Has health bar 100, stamina, wanted stars 0 to 5, money, respect level.

OPEN WORLD CITY - VERY BIG:
- Huge city with 5 neighborhoods: Centro, Favela, Praia, Bairro Rico, Zona Industrial.
- Streets with traffic, traffic lights, sidewalks, crosswalks.
- Buildings, houses you can enter, shops, hospital, police station, garage, gas station, beach, park.
- Day and night cycle, rain sometimes, cars and pedestrians walking around.
- Map / minimap in corner with player position.

CARS AND VEHICLES:
- 15 cars: popular car, sports car, police car, taxi, bus, truck, lowrider, SUV.
- 5 motorcycles.
- Press button to enter/exit car, drive with joystick, horn, radio with 3 songs.
- Car can crash, smoke, explode, can be repaired in garage for money.
- Player can steal car, buy car in car shop.

POLICE AND WANTED SYSTEM:
- Wanted stars 1 to 5.
- 1 star: 1 police on foot.
- 2 stars: police cars chase.
- 3 stars: roadblocks, helicopter.
- 4 stars: SWAT.
- 5 stars: army + helicopter + many police.
- Hide in house or change car to lose police.
- If arrested, pay fine. If die, go to hospital.

MONEY AND JOBS:
- Start with $500.
- Jobs to earn money:
1. Taxi Driver - take passengers to destination.
2. Delivery Boy - deliver pizza on motorcycle.
3. Mechanic - repair cars.
4. Street Racer - race against 3 rivals.
5. Rob bank - with police chase.
- Buy food to restore health, buy clothes, buy weapons, buy houses.

WEAPONS:
- Fist, Pistol, Shotgun, AK-47, Sniper.
- Buy in weapon shop, ammo system, reload button.
- Shooting with aim button.

MISSIONS - STORY MODE - 20 MISSIONS:
1. First Drive - learn to drive.
2. Taxi Day - do 3 taxi rides.
3. Pizza Delivery - deliver 5 pizzas in time.
4. First Fight - beat 3 gang members.
5. Bank Robbery - rob bank and escape police.
6. Street Race - win race in Centro.
7. Save Friend - rescue friend from gang in Favela.
8. Police Escape - lose 3 stars.
9. Beach Party - go to party and meet friends.
10. Car Theft - steal sports car.
11. Gang War - defend neighborhood.
12. Helicopter Chase - escape helicopter.
13. Big Heist - rob jewelry store.
14. Final Boss - fight mafia boss in Zona Industrial.
15. Free Roam - explore city freely.
+ 5 side missions: find hidden packages, collect 50 coins, find secret cars.

SIDE ACTIVITIES - LOTS TO DO:
- Play football in park.
- Swim in beach.
- Go to gym to increase strength.
- Go to barber to change hair.
- Go to clothes shop to buy new outfits.
- Buy house and decorate.
- Play mini-game: car wash, gambling, arcade.
- Collect 100 hidden coins around city for secret car.
- Take photos with camera.
- Listen to radio, change music.

NPCs:
- Pedestrians walking, talking, running from police.
- Gang members in Favela.
- Police, taxi drivers, shop sellers.
- Girlfriend character you can meet in Praia.

CONTROLS - MOBILE:
- Left joystick to walk/drive.
- Buttons on right: Jump, Punch, Shoot, Enter Car, Horn, Run.
- Touch to aim.
- Pause button with Map, Missions, Shop, Save Game.

GRAPHICS AND SOUND:
- Colorful 3D graphics, like GTA San Andreas but cleaner.
- Cartoon style, bright colors, smooth controls.
- Sound: car engine, gunshot, police siren, background music, footsteps.
- Vibration when crash or shoot.

SAVE SYSTEM:
- Auto-save every mission, save money, cars owned, houses, clothes, wanted level.

Make the game fun, fast, no bugs, easy controls, in Portuguese language (Brazil), with big tutorial at start.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, browser-based open-world GTA-style game called GRAND CITY LIFE 3D for desktop and Android.

## Requirements
- Portuguese (Brazil) interface.
- Young male main character in a Campina Grande-style city, with hoodies, cap, and sneakers.
- Walking, running, jumping, fighting, shooting, vehicle entry, driving, and motorcycles.
- Health, stamina, wanted stars, money, respect, missions, shops, jobs, saving, police, NPCs, vehicles, minimap, and mobile controls.
- 5 city neighborhoods, large open world, day/night, rain, traffic, buildings, shops, beach, park, and industrial zone.
- 20 missions plus side activities and collectible objectives.
- 15 cars and 5 motorcycles, vehicle purchasing, repair, crash, and radio features.
- Wanted system scaling from foot police through army/helicopter responses.
- Mobile joystick and action buttons.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a static HTML/Canvas game without external game frameworks.
- Used a stylized top-down/2.5D presentation rather than full 3D due to browser constraints.
- Kept the experience in Portuguese and added touch controls for mobile.
- Added localStorage autosave and manual save support.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the initial full interface and playable Canvas world in `index.html`.
- Added player stats, minimap, mission panel, pause/menu modal, shops, jobs, and tutorial.
- Added five neighborhoods, city buildings, roads, pedestrians, traffic, markers, beach, park, and vehicles.
- Added walking/running/jumping/punching/shooting, vehicle entry/exit, driving, horn, radio, stamina, and police wanted chase mechanics.
- Added 20 mission entries, 5 vehicle types/categories, 15 car models, 5 motorcycles, vehicle purchases, weapons, health kits, clothes, houses, jobs, collectibles, and local saving.
- Added police chase entities and helicopter display at higher wanted levels.
- Added basic day/night shading and weather/rain effects.
- Verified the JavaScript syntax with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js`.

### Active
- Browser capture/testing was not completed because Chromium was unavailable.

### Blocked
- Visual screenshot verification is blocked: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3000` failed because Chromium is not installed at `/home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome`.
- The game server process was started with `python3 -m http.server 3000`.

## Next Move
1. Install Chromium with `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`.
2. Open `http://localhost:3000` and capture a screenshot.
3. Inspect the screenshot and fix any canvas, UI, overflow, or tutorial issues.
4. Test movement, vehicle entry, mission progression, shops, jobs, police behavior, saving, and mobile controls in-browser.
5. Complete missing visual weather implementation and police/mission edge-case fixes if defects are found.

## Relevant Files
- `[index.html]`: Complete application and only application source file.
- `[/tmp/opencode/game.js]`: Extracted JavaScript used for syntax checking.

## Important Context
- The project is currently a static app served on port 3000.
- Browser testing could not proceed until Chromium is installed.
- The implementation is in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`.
- A local server was launched with `python3 -m http.server 3000`.
- Several features are implemented as simplified browser interactions rather than full real-time 3D behavior.
